tolerance.unit: ulps of the expected value (math.ulp) unless stated
tolerance.rationale: The library functions (Math.exp, Math.log, Math.sin, Math.cos, Math.pow) are not required to be correctly rounded; 4–8 ulps leaves headroom for other engines. `atDouble` is the correctly rounded value at the DOUBLES the TypeScript uses, so the first test measures the library; `value` + `bound` is the true value at the decimal input, so the second shows that feeding a double instead of the decimal is the only extra error. Exact values, kinds, locations, representatives and undefined/overflow policies must match EXACTLY.
